items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Lee (Stuart) or whoever it was he was working with at the Reno

ctx.x: Yeah, he'd go out to some of the bars on the corners, something, with all the guys. And when he was on his way down there to the band, Lee (Stuart) or whoever it was he was working with at the Reno, you'd see him already tore up, you know.

But then he started taking care of business. He would get drunk, you know: by the time we would leave he'd started getting drunk, you know. And then when we'd get down on 18th Street and Vine, you know, where the gang is, he'd get tore up. And I'd have to take him home.
